बॉक्स ऑफिस पर धमाल मचा रही फिल्म Ramayana को लेकर आ गई है एकदम चटपटी खबर! 🍿
5 नवंबर को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज हुई नितिश तिवारी की इस मेगा बजट फिल्म में यश रावण के रोल में हैं और काजल अग्रवाल लंका की रानी मंदोदरी बनी हैं।
काजल ने शनिवार को इंस्टाग्राम पर अपने लुक की तस्वीरें शेयर करते हुए कहा कि इस महागाथा का हिस्सा बनना उनके लिए गर्व की बात है।
एक्टर का कहना है कि भले ही उनका रोल छोटा है, लेकिन हमारी संस्कृति से जुड़ी इस कहानी का हिस्सा बनना उनके दिल को छू गया है।
काजल ने नमित मल्होत्रा और नितिश तिवारी को शुक्रिया कहा और रकुलप्रीत, विवेक ओबेरॉय व आदिनाथ कोठारे के साथ काम करने को शानदार अनुभव बताया।
फिल्म में रणबीर कपूर राम और साई पल्लवी सीता के रोल में हैं, जबकि यह दो भागों में रिलीज होनी है।
क्या आपने सिनेमाघर में जाकर Ramayana देखी और आपको काजल का यह छोटा सा रोल कैसा लगा? नीचे कमेंट करके तुरंत बताओ! 👇✨

ctx.title: Kajal Aggarwal admits that her role as Mandodari in Ramayana is small, says she is proud to be part of the film
ctx.summary: Kajal Aggarwal said it was a privilege to be associated with Ramayana, something so deeply rooted in our collective faith and divinity.
ctx.text:
Ramayana released in theatres on November 5. The Nitesh Tiwari film is garnering praise and doing well at the box office. Yash stars as Ravana in the film, and actor Kajal Aggarwal plays the character of Queen Mandodara. Her brief presence in the film also generated buzz on social media, as many viewers noted her unmissable presence on screen.
On Saturday, Kajal finally shared pictures of her look as Mandodari from the film in new Instagram post. Mandodari is the queen of Lanka and the virtuous wife of the demon king Ravana in the Hindu epic. Kajal shared that it is an immense moment of pride to be associated with a magnum opus like Ramayan, in any capacity. She added, “Albeit my role may be small, being part of a story that is so deeply woven into our culture, our history and our very existence, and being associated with a phenomenal team of such passionate and dedicated artists and technicians, truly fills my heart.”
“A heartfelt thank you to @iamnamitmalhotra and @niteshtiwari22 sir for thinking of me and giving me this opportunity to be a part of something that will forever be etched in our history, while also being a pioneering step from India towards global cinema,” she said.
A post shared by Kajal A Kitchlu (@kajalaggarwalofficial)
Kajal also thanked all the wonderful artists, and said that they were nothing short of phenomenal and an inspiration. “And to my dear friends @rakulpreet @vivekoberoi and @adinathkothare sharing screen space, conversations and so many laughs with you was an absolute joy!” she said.
The actor shared that some films aren’t measured by the length of a role or the minutes spent on screen, but by the magnitude of the story, the passion behind its making and the privilege of being associated with something so deeply rooted in our collective faith and divinity. “From the bottom of my heart, thank you to everyone for showering this beautiful piece of our cultural heritage with so much love, and for embracing my little yet meaningful character with such warmth and affection,” she added.
“Some associations are truly bigger than the role itself. Ramayan will always be one of them. And a very special shoutout to my wonderful team - @vardannayak @swapnilkashid_ @deepabambhaniya08 the costume department and our incredible assistant directors. You guys truly hit it out of the park! Your hard work, attention to detail and dedication made every bit of this journey special. All the appreciation and love coming your way is so well deserved. This one’s as much yours!” she concluded.
Ramayana is the latest adaptation of Valmiki's epic, one of the world's oldest pieces of literature. It tells the story of Lord Rama, the incarnation of Lord Vishnu and his battle against the asura king Ravana after the latter abducts his wife, Sita.
Produced by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios in collaboration with DNEG and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations, Ramayana is planned as a two-part film. The film stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. The first released worldwide on November 5, 2026, while the second part is set for Diwali 2028.
